traits.sympodium.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum (genus account), p. 3180 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the inflorescence is mostly sympodial, so it stands above the axil or opposite the leaves. Britton and Brown (vol. 3, Lycopersicon) put the tomato's cymes opposite the leaves.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum (genus account), p. 3180 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): corolla rotate or shallowly bell-shaped, plaited in bud.

traits.fruit_type.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum (genus account), p. 3180 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the fruit a berry.
